headline: Fierce Clashes Shake Stonecradle And Weathered Expanse As Godcrofts Quiets
war_summary: Combat has cooled dramatically across Godcrofts and Linn of Mercy, shifting violent intensity back toward the central and northern fronts. Stonecradle suddenly re-erupted over the last two hours, logging five rapid base turnovers around The Heir's Knife and World's End to leave the hex narrowly contested at four Warden strongholds to five Colonial. In Weathered Expanse, Warden counter-attacks clawed back ground into a 4–5 standing amid furious fighting that consumed more than 2,800 casualties in two hours alone. Stlican Shelf remains on a knife-edge at 5–4 in Warden favor following four fresh base transitions, while Dead Lands flared anew just before the wire with Warden troops storming Callahan's Gate. To the northwest, Callahan's Passage endures an accelerating bloodbath exceeding 2,900 casualties in two hours without altering its ten-post Warden grip, and Mooring County sees rising troop influxes testing the lone Colonial foothold.
